Round-trip: Stage 1 → generated text → Stage 2

STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: origen_050140.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: origen_050140.v · Open raw
module origen_050140 (
    input EX_MemR, EX_RegW,
    input [4:0] EX_WeSel,
    input MEM_MemR, MEM_RegW,
    input [4:0] MEM_WeSel,
    input [4:0] ID_oprs, ID_oprt,
    input ID_Branch, ID_BranchNE, ID_jump,
    input [1:0] ID_pcSel,
    input EX_Branch, EX_BranchNE, EX_jump,
    output reg Wr_PC, Wr_IFID, Wr_IDEX, Wr_EXMEM, Wr_MEMWB,
    output reg ClearCtrl_IDEX, ClearCtrl_EXMEM, ClearCtrl_MEMWB,
    output reg Bubble
);

    wire load_use_hazard, data_hazard_branch, control_hazard;

    // Load-Use Hazard
    assign load_use_hazard = EX_MemR && (EX_WeSel == ID_oprs || EX_WeSel == ID_oprt);

    // Data Hazard with Branches/Jumps
    assign data_hazard_branch = (ID_Branch || ID_BranchNE || ID_jump) &&
                                ((EX_RegW && (EX_WeSel == ID_oprs || EX_WeSel == ID_oprt)) ||
                                 (MEM_RegW && (MEM_WeSel == ID_oprs || MEM_WeSel == ID_oprt)));

    // Control Hazard
    assign control_hazard = EX_Branch || EX_BranchNE || EX_jump;

    always @(*) begin
        // Default values
        Wr_PC = 1'b1;
        Wr_IFID = 1'b1;
        Wr_IDEX = 1'b1;
        Wr_EXMEM = 1'b1;
        Wr_MEMWB = 1'b1;
        ClearCtrl_IDEX = 1'b0;
        ClearCtrl_EXMEM = 1'b0;
        ClearCtrl_MEMWB = 1'b0;
        Bubble = 1'b0;

        if (load_use_hazard) begin
            Wr_PC = 1'b0;
            Wr_IFID = 1'b0;
            ClearCtrl_IDEX = 1'b1;
        end else if (data_hazard_branch) begin
            Wr_PC = 1'b0;
            Wr_IFID = 1'b0;
            ClearCtrl_IDEX = 1'b1;
        end else if (control_hazard) begin
            ClearCtrl_IDEX = 1'b1;
            Bubble = 1'b1;
        end
    end

endmodule
STAGE 2

Generate the module

InputThe generated Stage 1 specification plus the required top-module name origen_050140.

Protocol summary; the Stage 2 runner creates a fresh prompt.

OutputReconstructed complete RTL module.
Stage 1 output → abstraction gate → fresh Stage 2 input. The intermediate text is generated separately for each model/attempt. It is not a prefilled golden description. Stage 2 receives neither the clean RTL nor the Stage 1 conversation.

Reference RTLClean RTL in the imported source record; hidden from Stage 2.

The formal oracle consumes the complete Stage 2 RTL file and compares it with the clean reference. A golden RTL file is scoring material, not a generated Stage 1 output.
